changelog:
WHAT'S NEW
• Snow Originals: our own videos, right in Live TV
• Rewind live TV, record channels and schedule recordings from the Guide
• Game Day: all your lines with service tags, more soccer (internationals, Europe, Liga MX), better channel picks, report a channel down
• The whole app in English, Español, Français, Deutsch or العربية
• New Home look and a new How to use SMC guide with real screenshots
• Plex picks the right quality for your connection
• Hold OK on a channel for a quick menu; sign-in keyboard jumps to Sign in
releaseNotes: Version 1.8.1: Snow Originals, our own videos in Live TV. Rewind live TV, record channels and schedule recordings from the Guide. Game Day uses every line you're signed into with a tag for each service, adds international and European soccer, lets you report a channel that's down, and lists only channels the guide confirms. The whole app now speaks English, Spanish, French, German or Arabic (Settings → Language). A new Home look, a new How to use SMC guide with real screenshots, smarter Plex quality on slower connections, a quick hold-OK channel menu, and the sign-in keyboard now jumps straight to Sign in.
